'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinian]] gunman opens fire inside a bus in [[Old City of Jerusalem|Jerusalem's Old City]], injuring eight people, two of them critically. [[Israeli police]] later raid the [[Silwan]] neighborhood, where the suspect lived, and arrest him. '''Disasters and accidents'''

**At least 41 people are killed and 45 others are injured in a fire at the Saint Mercurius [[Coptic Orthodox Church|Coptic Orthodox]] church in [[Giza]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-62541074 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 European and Mediterranean wildfires]]
**More than 1,500 people are evacuated from [[Zaragoza]], [[Spain]], due to [[wildfire]]s. [https://emeatribune.com/major-wildfire-in-spain-forces-the-evacuation-of-1500/ (EMEA Tribune)]
*[[2022 Yerevan explosion]]
**Six people are killed, 60 others injured and 18 more are missing in an explosion at a [[fireworks]] storage area of a mall in [[Yerevan]], [[Armenia]]. The city's mayor stated that there were people trapped under rubble. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/14/strong-explosion-hits-market-in-armenias-capital-yerevan (Al Jazeera)]
